annotations.title: Legislative activity across a North Carolina (NC) statute chapter

description:
How much legislative churn a North Carolina (NC) statute chapter has seen.

Use for "which parts of Chapter 14 keep changing". Returns amendment counts by year,
the most-amended sections with their totals, and counts of pending and repealed
sections. Omit `chapter` for a corpus-wide view.

Counts are STATUTORY, from history notes — not observations. For one section use
amendment_history; for upcoming text use pending_changes.
name: chapter_activity
title: Legislative activity across a North Carolina (NC) statute chapter
